findings.highlight: He resides in all
findings.evidenceJa: 至高にして全なるもの。
findings.governingReading: 至高にして全なる is supreme and whole/all-complete.
findings.explanation: Complete being becomes residence in all.

findings.highlight: some evils are tenacious in their corruption
findings.evidenceJa: 確固として魔は存在し
findings.governingReading: 確固として魔は存在し is definite existence, premise of contradiction.
findings.explanation: Certain existence becomes tenacity of corruption.

findings.highlight: some demons are particularly tenacious in their corruption
findings.evidenceJa: 繰り返すが確固として魔は存在し
findings.governingReading: The sentence reiterates the definite existence of demons before describing their corruption of people and the earth.
findings.explanation: The Japanese reaffirms that demons definitely exist. The English instead describes how tenaciously some demons corrupt people.

findings.highlight: They wreak ghastly tragedies
findings.evidenceJa: 凄惨な悲劇喜劇を演出する。
findings.governingReading: 凄惨な悲劇喜劇 pairs horrific tragedy and comedy.
findings.explanation: Tragicomic pairing loses comedy.

findings.highlight: In time, His children
findings.evidenceJa: 時に天の計りは
findings.governingReading: 時に is occasional instances of illusion of heavenly impotence.
findings.explanation: Sometimes becomes eventually.

findings.highlight: Those who hunt the faithless are themselves unbound by faith.
findings.evidenceJa: 教義にないモノを狩りとる彼らは、教義に縛られる事もない。
findings.governingReading: Entities not in doctrine hunted, hunters not bound by doctrine.
findings.explanation: Outside doctrine becomes faithless.

findings.highlight: That is the only thing they have in common with exorcists.
findings.evidenceJa: 一線を画すのは、ただその一点のみである。
findings.governingReading: 一線を画す states distinction.
findings.explanation: Exorcist distinction becomes similarity.

findings.highlight: his left arm contains
findings.evidenceJa: 右腕には
findings.governingReading: 右腕 locates inherited Command Spells.
findings.explanation: Right arm becomes left arm.

findings.highlight: The rippling of flesh.
findings.evidenceJa: 溶ける肉の音。
findings.governingReading: 溶ける is flesh dissolution with heard sound.
findings.explanation: Melting becomes rippling flesh.

findings.highlight: the made warrior.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠退いていく狂戦士の足音を。
findings.governingReading: 狂戦士 names Berserker.
findings.explanation: Mad warrior becomes made warrior.

findings.highlight: My leg muscles tear, and I cry out in pain
findings.evidenceJa: 足の筋肉が断裂しかけて
findings.governingReading: 断裂しかけて muscles about to tear; their personified cry warns of bone snapping.
findings.explanation: Incipient tear and muscles crying become tear and boy crying.

findings.highlight: my bones are going to burst out of my thighs.
findings.evidenceJa: 股から骨がブチ折れるぞ
findings.governingReading: 股から骨がブチ折れるぞ threatens bones snapping.
findings.explanation: Snapping thigh bones become protruding bones.

findings.highlight: my heart muscles will cramp
findings.evidenceJa: 心筋が硬直し停止しようとしている
findings.governingReading: 硬直し停止しよう includes imminent stop.
findings.explanation: Impending heart stoppage reduced to cramp.

findings.highlight: I managed to grab a tree trunk
findings.evidenceJa: 自分から幹にぶつかる事で停止させた。
findings.governingReading: 自分から幹にぶつかる halts flight by striking trunk; hammer-like back impact follows.
findings.explanation: Deliberate collision becomes successful grab.

findings.highlight: If I have one minute to breathe, I can run.
findings.evidenceJa: 一息分の呼吸があれば地面を蹴れる。
findings.governingReading: 一息分 repeats52 single breath enough to push off.
findings.explanation: One breath becomes one minute.

findings.highlight: She's fixated on the dark enemy's identity.
findings.evidenceJa: それが、黒い敵の正体だった。
findings.governingReading: それが黒い敵の正体だった reveals enemy identity after her naming Berserker.
findings.explanation: Identity revelation becomes Illya fixation.

findings.highlight: from four meters away
findings.evidenceJa: それもわずか二間
findings.governingReading: それもわずか二間 measures maximum sideways leap allowed in previous sentence.
findings.explanation: Jump displacement becomes separation from arm.

findings.highlight: Only Assassin's arm took any damage.
findings.evidenceJa: 直撃するのはアサシンの魔腕のみ。
findings.governingReading: 直撃するのはアサシンの魔腕のみ is only cursed arm landing direct hit.
findings.explanation: Arm landing direct hit becomes arm taking damage.

findings.highlight: even at this range.
findings.evidenceJa: この体勢で放てば黒鍵は命中する。
findings.governingReading: この体勢で放てば specifies bodily configuration throwing.
findings.explanation: Throwing posture becomes range.

findings.highlight: While the priest celebrates the fact
findings.evidenceJa: 傷を負わせたという功績をもって
findings.governingReading: 功績 credits accomplishment before predicted death.
findings.explanation: Wounding achievement becomes celebration.

findings.highlight: He's astonished for two reasons.
findings.evidenceJa: 一つは黒鍵によって動きを封じられたアサシン、
findings.governingReading: 一つは…アサシン then another leads76 Zouken speaking astonishment at survival.
findings.explanation: Two astonished parties become Assassin two reasons.

findings.highlight: Was this always his objective from the beginning?
findings.evidenceJa: 初めからソレだけだと言っていたではないか。
findings.governingReading: 言っていたではないか reminds he already said his target15–16.
findings.explanation: Already-stated aim becomes uncertain question.

findings.highlight: slams it into the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: そのまま地上へと落下する。
findings.governingReading: Head grasped and Kirei falls to ground with him.
findings.explanation: Falling holding head becomes head slamming ground.

findings.highlight: To my self given flesh, I swear thus.
findings.evidenceJa: 受肉した私が誓う
findings.governingReading: 受肉した私が誓う incarnate I subject of swearing.
findings.explanation: Incarnate speaker swears becomes oath to incarnate self.

findings.highlight: Yes, there will be no eternity for you.
findings.evidenceJa: そう、おまえには永遠にない。
findings.governingReading: 永遠に modifies not having ordinary happiness from87.
findings.explanation: Never having happiness becomes no eternity.

findings.highlight: Within that magecraft foundation, Baptism Rites are said to be the most powerful tool against spirits.
findings.evidenceJa: 固定化された魔術基盤の中でも、最大の対霊魔術とされる。
findings.governingReading: Scriptures among world-fixed foundations foremost anti-spirit magic.
findings.explanation: Foundation compared among foundations becomes tool within foundation.
